name: dsh-chat-ux

one_liner.zh: 为 DSH 网页聊天区增加纸感、自动折叠、输入与读数动效及系统通知。
one_liner.en: Adds chat styling, folding, composer effects, readouts and system notices to the DSH web client.

local: 需要 DSH Web GUI 与浏览器 Notification API（通知功能在 API 不可用时不启用）。

install.dsh_version: README 说明最低支持 0.2.1-alpha.1；package engines 要求 Node ^22.19.0 或 >=24.0.0。

skipped: src/client/chat/paper/** and remaining chat modules (only selected core modules were sampled for this B-tier assessment).

readme_mismatch: README.en.md describes five paper styles and three rooms, while the Chinese README describes one paper; paper configuration implementation was not fully inspected, so the discrepancy is unresolved.
